description: Ed25519 signatures over CBOR (BSIP-2 comments, BSIP-3 community record, BSIP-5 comment update, BSIP-6 vote). signedCborHex = cborg.encode of the record restricted to signature.signedPropertyNames, null/undefined values dropped (the bytes pkc-js verifies). pkcJs = results of pkc-js functions; signatureOnly is _validateSignatureOfPKCRecord (signature check alone). TEST KEYS ONLY: never use them outside tests.

generatedWith.method: signed with the pkc-js sign* functions, checked with its verify*/decrypt functions, by a standalone Node script (not committed)

vectors.name: vote-with-unsigned-extra-field
vectors.description: An unlisted field leaves the signed bytes unchanged, so the signature verifies, but verifyVote rejects any field not in signedPropertyNames.

verifyVote.reason: VotePubsubMessagePublication record includes a field that's not included in signature.signedPropertyNames

vectors.name: post-comment-ipfs-with-unknown-unsigned-field
vectors.description: A fetched CommentIpfs may carry unsigned fields that are not comment fields (depth, previousCid, unknown fields): verifyCommentIpfs accepts.

vectors.name: post-comment-ipfs-with-unsigned-signable-field
vectors.description: A comment field (nsfw) present but not in signedPropertyNames: the signature verifies, verifyCommentIpfs rejects (pkc-js issue #249).

verifyCommentIpfs.reason: CommentIpfs record includes an author-signable field that's not included in signature.signedPropertyNames

vectors.name: community-record-with-unsigned-posts
vectors.description: posts added without being signed: the signature verifies, verifyCommunity rejects.

verifyCommunity.reason: CommunityIpfs record includes a field not included in signature.signedPropertyNames

vectors.name: vote-signed-field-altered
vectors.description: vote changed from -1 to 1 after signing: the signature fails.

vectors.name: null-in-signed-property-treated-as-absent
vectors.description: nsfw: null is listed but verifiers skip null values, so the original signature (made without nsfw) verifies. The wire schema rejects null.

pkcJs.schema: invalid: nsfw: Invalid input: expected boolean, received null

vectors.name: null-in-signed-property-signed-as-cbor-null
vectors.description: Signed over nsfw: null as CBOR null (signedByPkcJsHex). The verifier drops the null (signedCborHex) and rejects.

vectors.name: signedPropertyNames-reordered-with-absent-name
vectors.description: The order of signedPropertyNames is irrelevant (CBOR maps are sorted) and a listed name missing from the record is skipped.

vectors.name: comment-update-with-padded-base64
vectors.description: signature/publicKey with '=' padding: the decoder accepts them, but verifyCommentUpdate compares publicKey strings and rejects.

verifyCommentUpdate.reason: Comment update is not signed by the community

vectors.name: cbor-encoding-examples
vectors.description: cborg.encode(value, pkc-js options). -0 encodes as 0; non-integers and unsafe integers use the shortest exact float; undefined throws.

examples.note: map keys: shorter first, then bytewise
integer above 2^53-1: encoded as the shortest exact float
